stem.text: When ethanol reacts with sodium metal, ethoxide ions, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{O}^{-}$, are produced.
When water reacts with sodium metal, $\text{OH}^{-}$ ions are produced.
Which statement about these reactions and the ethoxide ion is correct?

A.text: At the same temperature, the rate of reaction between sodium and ethanol is greater than that between sodium and water.

B.text: $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{O}^{-}$ is a stronger base than $\text{OH}^{-}$ due to the electron-donating effect of the ethyl group.

C.text: The negative charge on the oxygen in an ethoxide ion is delocalised.

D.text: It is easier to deprotonate ethanol as it is more acidic than water.
